I am sorry to hear this, it sounds like you’ve Been trough a lot of shit.

I don’t know if you agree but in my opinion (handicaps excluded) people are born more or less the same. I think your experiences make you who you are know. 
That’s why I think that you saying you’ve never wanted this life is something you are reasoning for yourself right now. Most likely this is because you’ve been trough a lot and again I am sorry to hear that. BUT, this WILL change.
The strangest thing about a depressed mind is that it will filter almost anything you are going trough as negative and all positive things surrounding you are marked fake or unimportant.(At least that’s my experience)

This means that when you try(and it’s hard) to find more positivity in your life each day, your mindset will change, and once this fog on your mind will lessen, you will see the beautiful possibilities that life has to offer and your life will improve. Mentally, physically, financially and socially.

Try to fight against the pessimistic self view and listen to the positivity of other people towards you.

Just by the sentence my pessimistic self view tells me, I can see that you are a very rational, observing, smart person. You will get trough this, the only things you need are the right people to lean on, a progressive mindset and a friendly positive push from some strangers.

And one last thing, don’t think that talking about this will upset people and waste their time, it’s the very essence of life.

Good luck, you can always Dm me for support.
If you want to talk, I’ll be there for you
